interface.signature: def smallestWindow(S: str, P: str) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in S) and all(c.islower() for c in P)
preconditions.description: All characters in S and P are lowercase alphabets.
Lengths of S and P are at least 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value) == len(P) and all(P.count(c) <= return_value.count(c) for c in set(P)))
postconditions.description: If a valid window exists, return_value is the smallest substring of S containing all characters of P (including duplicates). If no such window exists, return_value is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(c in S for c in P)
postconditions.description: If return_value is not '-1', then all characters in P must exist in S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value) == min(len(window) for window in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1)] if all(P.count(c) <= window.count(c) for c in set(P))))
postconditions.description: If multiple windows of the same minimal length exist, return_value is the one with the smallest starting index.
